snippet.title: Totopia - Official Trailer | ID@Xbox April 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Here's your look at Totopia in this trailer for the upcoming free-to-play party game. Party with your friends and check out mini-games, gameplay, and more in this trailer. 
Totopia will be available on Xbox.
